newsitem.title: GREECE: Citibank's Athens Index 1 gathered 1.8bln drachmas.
newsitem.headline: Citibank's Athens Index 1 gathered 1.8bln drachmas.

text.p: Subscriptions to Citibank's Athens Index 1 fund, the first capital guaranteed fund on the Greek market linked to the Athens bourse general index, reached 1.8 billion drachmas during the pre-subscription period, Citibank said in a statement.
The pre-subscription period to the fund lasted from January 2 to January 17.
The Citi Athens Index 1 fund will be capped at 23.28 percent, twice the one-year Athibor of 11.64 percent on January 20, it said.
The minimum guaranteed fund share price is 2.5 million drachmas, it said.

The base level of the Athens stock general index that will be used for return calculations will be equal to 1,096.83 points which is the arithmetic average of the closing prices of the general index from January 20 through January 24, it said.
